                    ### Question

Her weight is 81 kg (178.6 lb) and the height is 169 cm (5 ft 6 in). She has gained 13 kg (28.6 lb) during the pregnancy. She has no abnormalities on physical examination. Which of the following screening tests should be obtained ?

                    ### Options

opb. Non-fasting oral glucose tolerance test with 50 g of glucose
opc. Fasting oral glucose test with 50 g of glucose
opd. Non-fasting oral glucose load test with 75 g of glucose
ope. Measurement of HbA1c

The non-fasting oral glucose tolerance test with 50 g of glucose is a common screening test for gestational diabetes and is appropriate in this case. Fasting glucose level may not be as sensitive for detecting gestational diabetes, so other screening tests should be considered.
